name: Scored in every inning
title: Teams that scored in every inning they batted, 1901 on
description: Every AL and NL game since 1901 (postseason included) in which a team scored at least one run in each inning it came to bat, in date order, from MLB's line scores. Only three did it through nine full turns at bat: the 1923 Giants, the 1964 Cardinals and the 1999 Rockies. A home team that won without batting in the ninth had eight turns; rain-shortened games count the innings played. Add {Innings: Batted} >= 9 to the conditions to keep the nine-inning ones alone.
